days.note: Header read off the graphic: SET TIMES · FRI MARCH 22 BAYFRONT · MARCH 22 BAYFRONT PARK 2024 · FROM 4:00 PM TO 12:00 AM. Seven stage columns: ULTRA MAIN STAGE, WORLDWIDE STAGE, MEGASTRUCTURE and THE COVE on the left panel, LIVE STAGE, UMF RADIO and OASIS on the right; stage names are the column logos, uppercased. The UMF RADIO column prints a host logo under it each day (OPHELIA Friday, DIRTY WORKZ Saturday, purified Sunday); the stage is UMF RADIO. Every block prints a start only ("9:15 PM"), so every row is open-ended. A smaller coloured line under a name (LIVE, A/V, a presents line) is kept in parentheses after it, as printed. The original upload was never archived; this is the site's own 1600x1000 resized copy, which is legible. Friday was shut down at about 9:00 PM for severe weather (Billboard, 23 March 2024), just before HARDWELL's main-stage set, so the 14 sets printed at 9:00 PM or later did not happen and are not listed: FISHER x CHRIS LAKE (PRESENT UNDER CONSTRUCTION), HARDWELL, ARMIN VAN BUUREN, ARMIN VAN BUUREN B2B OLIVER HELDENS, AMELIE LENS, JORIS VOORN B2B KÖLSCH, ZEDS DEAD (A/V), MASTERHAND, OPHELIA B2B2B, ANDREW BAYER, BLANKE, TAK SHAK, JUSTIN RABIN, LIAM WALTERS. OPHELIA's block prints B2B2B with no partners named.
